blocks.text: Sulfur rubber ki molecular zanjeeron (chains) ko aapas mein jorne wala (cross linker) ka kaam karta hai. Is amal ko vulcanisation kehte hain, aur is se rubber mazboot ho jata hai (Figure 12.10).

blocks.alt: Do lambi, uljhi hui narangi polymer zanjeerein. Chaar jagah S atoms ka ek jora zanjeeron ke do hisson ko jorta hai: har S ek chhoti lakeer se zanjeer se jura hai aur dono S aapas mein jure hain. Oopar wala ek S-S jora daire mein hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.10: Polymer zanjeeron ke darmiyan S-S cross-linkages (kitab ki Figure 12.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Vulcanisation se pehle rubber ki zanjeerein ek doosre par phisal sakti hain, is liye rubber naram aur chipchipa hota hai. Sulfur S-S pul (bridges) bana kar zanjeeron ko jagah jagah bandh deta hai, is liye vulcanised rubber zyada mazboot aur lachakdar hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Rubber ki vulcanisation mein sulfur ka kya kirdar hai (exercise Q.2k)?
blocks.explanation: Kachche rubber ko sulfur ke saath garam karne par sulfur paas paas ki polymer zanjeeron ke darmiyan S–S pul (cross-links) banata hai. Ab zanjeerein ek doosre par phisal nahi saktin, is liye rubber zyada mazboot, lachakdar (elastic) aur kam chipchipa ho jata hai.

items: Vulcanisation: sulfur rubber ki zanjeeron ko S–S pulon se jorta hai; rubber mazboot hota hai.
